steps.start: the junction of the north bank of McGillivray Creek and Little Sumas River
steps.quote: Commencing at the junction of the north bank of McGillivray Creek and Little Sumas River

steps.until: the south shoreline of the Fraser River
steps.quote: thence in a northerly and westerly direction following the east and north banks of the Little Sumas River to the south shoreline of the Fraser River

steps.until: Miller Slough where it enters the Fraser River
steps.quote: thence following the south shoreline of the Fraser River in a northeasterly, southeasterly and easterly direction to Miller Slough where it enters the Fraser River

steps.until: the south boundary of the Provincial Dyke
steps.quote: thence southerly following the west bank of Miller Slough to the south boundary of the Provincial Dyke

steps.until: the north bank of McGillivray Creek
steps.quote: thence southwesterly and southerly along the south boundary of the dyke to the north bank of McGillivray Creek
thence westerly along the north bank of McGillivray Creek to the point of commencement
